This petition has been filed for quashing of the FIR No.24/2010 registered under Sections 498A/323/504 IPC & 3/4 of D.P. Act at PS Hapur Ghaziabad, U.P., on the ground of a settlement between the parties dated 14.10.2015 arrived at with the facilitation of the Delhi Mediation Centre,
Karkardooma Courts.
As per the settlement, an amount of Rs.21 Lakhs is to be paid to respondent No.2, out of which an amount of Rs.8 Lakhs is pending.
2. Petitioner No.1, 2 & 3 and the respondent No.2/complainant are present in the Court, duly identified by the counsels and the IO.
The petitioner No.1 states that he needs time to make balance amount.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 17:58:28 3.
Last and final opportunity is given to the petitioner to comply with the settlement.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
